Author: Solona
Name: Proteus
Description:
• Lets you use overlays — skin-tight gear, tattoos, scales and the like — as a regular Penumbra mod you can toggle on and off, recolour, bind to Glamourer designs and collections, and more.

• Overlays render two ways. Painted into your skin, except now your overlays are dyeable. Or as a second skin, which lets you use sphere maps, metalness and animated glow that skin materials can't do.

• Reshape any mod's models. Paint on your character to pull clothing clear of your body, push it in, smooth it, stretch it across a hollow, or paint where the wind sways it. Hair works too. Edits save into the mod and can be undone.

• Add on/off switches to any part of any mod.

• Make modded hair fit under hats, and undo it any time.

• Import regular old mods and equip them without using a gear slot.

• Save a mod's look as a preset you can wear, share and swap.

• Imports Penumbra .pmp, Onion .omp and Atramentum Luminis .ttmp2 glow tattoos, with no shader mod needed.

• Cloth overlays can enable skindenting with one click.

Type /proteus to manage your Proteus mods.
Punchline: Overlays, off-slot gear and model editing for Penumbra mods
Changelog:
Point at a colour row to find it, hair ports across the sexes, every variant of your gear, and Dawntrail shaders

Colors
- Point at a row button (#01-#16) and that row lights up on your character while the pointer stays on it: gear
  rows colour-cycle, skin rows turn gold after a moment.
- Rows your index textures select rarely or never are hidden. Tick "Show all rows" to see them.
- The rows the editor counts as used now include every overlay of an option, and follow an index texture you
  edit while the window is open.
- Closing the Colors window, or Proteus's window, turns a skin Glow off.

Hair
- The Studio can port a hairstyle to the other sex ("Also for the other sex"). Proteus never does this by itself.
- A port to the other sex gets its own material, so one race of the other sex can be ported on its own.
- Ported hair no longer sinks into bigger heads and shows bald spots.

Gear
- Gear variants (Settings, on by default): wearing another colour variant of an item a mod replaces now draws the
  mod's material, like TexTools' "Apply to all variants". Written into the mod, with undo.
- Upgrade old gear to Dawntrail shaders (Settings, off by default): worn mods' old characterlegacy materials are
  rewritten to Dawntrail's character shader, backed up first, with undo.
- The shader upgrade never loses an original material, and keeps the original of a material you edit afterwards.
- Gear darkened by an older wind save gets its own colours back.

Body size and refit
- The size set sizes a piece in the option group Penumbra actually draws it from (Equinox's bottoms are made now).
- When two sources fit a piece equally, the size set picks the body mod.
- A crossed shoe's or glove's cloth is read from a body Proteus knows before any other mod.
- Nails under a bodysuit leave a smooth finger instead of a nail bed, and follow what your body mod's options hide.
- Skin overlays read only the chest your body mod draws (much faster on NIRÆ).
- "Cap the toes" covers just the toes, and says when the mod's own Toe Cap is a single-choice group.
- A size-set piece whose own files are missing is no longer asked to pick "Made on".

Please say if anything looks wrong.

Author: Solona
Name: Camera Tools
Description:
• Presents FFXIV's camera to ReShade as an IGCS camera tool, which is what accumulation depth-of-field add-ons need in order to work. Nothing has ever provided one for FFXIV before.

• Works with iMMERSE Parallax DoF and Otis_Inf's IGCS Depth of Field, and with their panorama and multishot capture.

• Frame the shot however you already do — Group Pose, Cammy, Brio. The camera is only taken over while an add-on is stacking frames, and handed straight back afterwards, so this does not compete with anything else you use.

• Requires ReShade 6.4+ with add-on support, plus a compatible depth-of-field add-on.

Type /camtools to see whether an add-on is connected.
Punchline: Lets ReShade's accumulation depth-of-field add-ons drive the GPose camera.
